name: Coordinated landings
description: Gameplay change: troop ships invading the same planet land together. A transport that reaches the planet holds in orbit (troops still aboard) until every other transport of its empire that is attacking the same planet has arrived too, or until a set number of days after the first one arrived; then they all unload at once. Applies to every empire, you included. Pirate raids and pirate troops are never held. Set on the new-game wizard's Other Empires page (on by default whenever Smarter AI is on).

params.name: clTimeoutDays
params.label: Transports that have arrived land anyway this many game days after the first one arrived
